structuralFindings: Entirely different pricing unit from Chale Island/Nomad: priced PER VILLA (whole-unit rate) with a minimum headcount, not per person — Regular Season based on min 6 pax, Festive based on min 8 pax. This is the 3rd distinct pricing shape found across the 3 Sands/Chale-Nomads sub-properties in this batch (per-person-sharing at Chale/Nomad vs per-villa-with-minimum-pax here).

Only 2 seasons shown on this document (Regular, Festive) — no separate Spring season band exists for the Villas, unlike Chale Island and Nomad Beach Resort which both have a distinct cheaper Spring window. [Unverified] whether this is a genuine structural difference or the Spring rate simply wasn't printed on this card — read as printed, don't assume Spring pricing exists for the Villa unless confirmed separately.
Base meal plan is Half Board, matching Chale Island but not Nomad's Bed & Breakfast base.

4 villas at 2 distinct price points: Lazy Days and The Family Cottage share IDENTICAL rates ($1,470/$3,192 and identical additional-adult/child figures) despite being named/configured differently (8 rooms/16 pax vs 6 rooms/12 pax) — flagged as a genuine finding, not an extraction error; re-checked both rows independently from source.

Child policy differs from Chale/Nomad: here it's 0-2 free, 3-16 = 'Child Rates' (i.e., the Additional Child figure), 16+ = Adult rates — the child/adult cutoff age (16) is notably higher than Chale/Nomad's 12.
